title: Battlefield 6 Season 5 brings Vegas and Dead Space 🎰
subject: battlefield6
description:
Would you play a Dead Space mode in Battlefield? 👇

EA revealed the Battlefield 6 Season 5 roadmap on October 9, 2026. The season starts October 13 with the Vegas Strip and Area 51 maps, 4 new weapons and the REDSEC Rapid Royale mode, followed by a limited-time Dead Space Convergence event for Halloween. Platoons and a server browser arrive December 8.

Sources: EA Battlefield 6 Season 5 Roadmap (Oct 9, 2026), This Week in Videogames (Oct 9, 2026), GamingBolt (Oct 9, 2026)
Game footage/images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Battlefield 6 is heading to Las Vegas.
EA's Season 5 starts October 13 with two new maps: Vegas Strip and Area 51.
Launch day also adds 4 new weapons and Rapid Royale, a faster battle royale mode for REDSEC.
Then comes a Dead Space crossover for Halloween, where soldiers uncover an alien Marker beneath Area 51.
A European Casino map comes later, and Platoons and a server browser arrive December 8.
EA says more Dead Space details will come closer to the event.
